lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Rain on the bark. Grip's worse, hinge is the same. Mind your feet.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Wind's pushing the tops. Wait for the lull, then cut.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Storm's up. Nobody fells in this. I'm not arguing about it.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Dry ground and no rain coming. Days like this, you count high.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Past a quarter of the island now. I've been counting. It's going.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Half the island's down. Halfway's where crews get sloppy. Not us.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Three quarters done. The last of it's always on the worst ground. Remember that.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Stumps out to the next rise now. Every one of mine you could set a cup on.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: On a slope the tree wants downhill. Let it, or plan for a fight.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Mud's taking boots. Short steps. Nobody runs with a log in this.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Undergrowth's thick here. Clear yourself a way out before you cut. Always an escape route.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Light's going. Last one, then in. Everyone.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Rain's set in. Bark's slick, but the work isn't going anywhere.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Then we change the order and take the ones leaning with it. Good eye.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: You can see water from here now. Couldn't when we started.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Lovely. Now look at all the stumps in front of it. Also lovely.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Birds have moved off this end. Too much noise. They'll find somewhere quieter.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Wind's up, boss. I'm picking trees that lean with it. The rest can wait.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Nine in ten down. Near enough I could count what's left from the yard.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Wet log. Twice the weight, half the grip, and it's still got an attitude.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Wind's trying to take my hat. It can have it if it carries a log as well.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Dry day. Logs are lighter. Well, they're not, but they feel it.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Listen to that on the roof. Proper weather for a second breakfast.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Mud's got my boot. Hang on. Right. Me and the boot are reunited.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Downhill with a log is easy. Uphill with a log is a personality test.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: River's running fast after all this. Wouldn't fancy a swim. Biscuit would, mind.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Brambles had my sleeve. They can keep it. I've got another shirt at camp, I think.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Fair few gaps out there already. Island's starting to look like it had a haircut.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Half the trees gone, mates. Half! Somebody should make a cake.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: You can see the sea from here now. Makes the walk back feel shorter, somehow.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Stumps everywhere. It's like a very slow game of hopscotch with a log on.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Getting dark, mate. Dinner's waiting, and so's the dog.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Birds cleared off this side ages ago. Can't blame them. It's all chainsaws and me singing.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Neither am I, not until I've had a cup of tea.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Push you? Mate, I'll carry the truck if it comes to it.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Sounds like rain coming to me. And rain sounds like soup weather.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Wet one, mate. Good day for being a duck. Or a cook.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Sun on the water. If it weren't for the logs, I'd call this a holiday.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Your knee said that yesterday, mate. Your knee's a pessimist.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Wind's gusting in the crowns. I'll time the back cut for the gaps between.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: The wind's backed round since earlier. The tops are leaning the other way now.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Rain's soaking the leaf litter. Any slope round here will be slick within the hour.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Storm's building, boss. The gusts are moving whole crowns. I wouldn't fell in it.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Dry bark today. Cleaner cuts, less sap. You can hear the difference in the blade.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: If it's leaning downhill, fell it with the lean, not against it. The slope always wins.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Ground's softer under the ferns. There's water close to the surface somewhere here.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: The river's running brown. That's runoff from the bare slopes. Less root to hold the soil.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: The undergrowth's taller where the canopy opened. Light gets in, and everything grows.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: We're past a tenth. I've been shading in the cleared blocks on my map.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Over a quarter cleared. The wind moves differently over open ground. You can feel it at the edges.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Three quarters cleared. Much of what's left is on awkward ground. We took the easy ones first, naturally.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Light's going flat. It's harder to judge a lean like this. I'd stop after this one.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Fewer birds on this side. I've watched them going over to the stands we haven't reached.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: The older stumps are already greying in the sun. It happens faster than people think.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: You can see the sea from much more of the island now, boss. It makes finding your way easier.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: It's not shorter. It just feels that way when you can see where you're going.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Your knee was wrong twice last week. I wrote it down.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Keep to the high side of the ruts. It's firmer where the roots are.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Rain's on. Second gear, no sudden steering. The truck's happiest slow in this.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: The lane's going to be all ruts after this rain. I might need a push later. Sorry in advance.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Is it okay if we head in? The storm's getting louder. Sorry. I just think we should.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: The trees are really moving. Is that normal? Sorry. It's probably normal.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Dry lane today. The truck almost feels like it's on a real road.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Mud's deep at the low bits. I'll take it wide and keep the wheels turning.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Low gear on the downhill. Nobody touch anything. Please.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Is it dusk? It looks like dusk. Sorry, I just like to know.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: The route's easier with fewer trees about. I can see round the corners now.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Half the island! I'm telling Ana. She'll ask what it looks like. Mostly stumps, I'll say.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: You can see the water the boat will come in on. Well, the water. No boat yet.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: There were loads of birds in these trees when we got here. They've moved. Because of us, I think. The saws are loud.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Something grabbed my whole arm. Oh. Brambles. Sorry. It's just brambles.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Steering round stumps now. It's like a cone course. I used to be good at those.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: The truck lane's going to be soup. Is it okay if I take it slow today?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Can you see the dock from here? Sorry. I just like knowing where it is.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Cabin roof's just there. Nearly in. Is everyone behind me?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: The rain's good for one thing, boss. The truck gets washed for free.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: The river's louder than it was. Is that rain from further up? Priya would know.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: It is nice. It makes the boat feel closer. Is that silly?

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Rain again. There'll be wet socks on every chair in the cabin tonight. I can feel it coming.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: My knee says rain tomorrow. My knee has never once been wrong.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Wind's got opinions today. Hold on to your helmet, sunshine.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Storm out there. Kettle in here. I know which one I'm picking.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Lovely day for it. If this were a bar terrace, I'd be selling cider by the jug.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Mud to the ankle. These boots will be the ruin of the cabin floor.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Who put a hill here? Somebody write to the company.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: We've made a dent. Not a big one, but there's sky where there wasn't.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Half of it's gone, loves. Half! That's worth a proper pudding tonight.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Nearly bare out there now. I'll almost miss the shade. Almost.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Look at that, the sea. Isn't that lovely, after weeks of nothing but trunks?

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Sea view and a log on your shoulder. People pay good money for half of that.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: I miss the dawn birds. They've gone off to the far trees. Now I wake up to the kettle.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Light's going, sunshine. Let's be in before it goes altogether.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: All these stumps. Somebody should've planted chairs in them.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Ferns up to my waist in here. If I go missing, follow the complaining.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Sun's out, boss-love. Everybody's happier. You could ask for anything today.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: We'll all push, sunshine. Dale will push and tell us about it for a week.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Rain's good for one thing. Nobody argues about taking the long lunch.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Wet bark. Slow and steady on this one.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Gusts in the tops. Waiting for a lull.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Storm's too strong to fell in. Holding off.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Dry and bright. Good working weather.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Mud's sucking at my boots. Careful steps.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: More sky than canopy out here now.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Not much forest left to clear. The island looks bigger without it.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Sun's low. Time to wrap up.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Roots everywhere under this growth. Watch your ankles.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Halfway cleared, everyone. The second half's never quicker, but at least we know the ground now.

lines.speaker: trait:observant
lines.text: Wind's shifted a few degrees. Checking the lean again before I commit.

lines.speaker: trait:observant
lines.text: Ground's drying faster where the canopy's gone. You can see the line between the two.

lines.speaker: trait:timid
lines.text: Getting dark. Can we start heading back? Just to be early.

lines.speaker: trait:timid
lines.text: I don't like how loud the storm gets in the trees. Can we go in?

lines.speaker: trait:reliable_driver
lines.text: Low gear, steady throttle. The route holds if you don't rush it.

lines.speaker: trait:reliable_driver
lines.text: Route's opened right up. Hardly a blind corner left.

lines.speaker: trait:stronger
lines.text: Wet log, heavy log. I'll take it.

lines.speaker: trait:level_headed
lines.text: It's only weather. We wait it out, then we go again.

lines.speaker: trait:sociable
lines.text: Rain's settled in, {listener}. Good excuse for a long chat under the eaves.

lines.speaker: trait:hard_working
lines.text: Bit of rain never ruined a good day. Keep going.

lines.speaker: trait:skeptical
lines.text: Wind always sounds worse in a forest than it is. Old trees creak.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Storm's up, boss. I've stopped felling till it passes.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Calm water today. You can see a long way out.
